name: Myanmar
value: Airstrike on Rakhine IDP camp killed 12, 13 Nov
summary: Witnesses say a military airstrike killed 12 at a Rakhine displacement camp on 13 Nov; no major city changed hands
state: Witnesses and a rescue group said a military airstrike on the Byar La displacement camp in Ponnagyun township, Rakhine State, killed 12 people, including a five-year-old, and injured 18 on the evening of 13 Nov (AFP via Arab News). On 6 Nov the election commission announced by-elections in 39 constituencies for 4 April 2027 as fighting continues in Sagaing, Mandalay and Chin; ACLED says the war has killed over 100,000 people (The Star). No major city changing hands or cross-border escalation was found as of 17 Nov, so Watch holds.
for_you: The FCDO advises against travel to large parts of Myanmar; check its travel advice. The war drives refugee flows to Bangladesh and Thailand and disrupts trade routes with China and India.
rubric_hit: Watch: civil war at sustained intensity; no major city fallen or cross-border escalation as of 17 Nov

why: A multi-sided civil war affecting 50 million people, with spillover to China, Thailand, India and Bangladesh.
